heading: The opt-in: per-emit TTL override
text:
### The opt-in: per-emit TTL override [LDTL.1.2]

`dynamic_ttl` enables the `retain: <expr>` kwarg on `emit`
actions for `ttl`-lifecycle schemas. It overrides the
schema-level TTL for that one emission: the fact's deadline is its entry
stamp plus the evaluated duration ([LDTL.4.1]), not known until
rule-firing time.  Because different facts of the same schema can now
have different expiry times, the FIFO order within a schema is broken:
a later-asserted fact may expire before an earlier one.

The engine falls back to the **deadline min-heap** to correctly order
arbitrary expiry deadlines.  Cost: O(log N_ttl) per insert/remove,
O(expired × log N_ttl) per tick ([LDTL.4.2], [LDTL.6.3]). The engine's tick in
this edition costs [LDTL.6.4]'s.
